_source: Base route distilled from Fextralife's Game Progress Route / Recommended Levels + wiki.gg cross-check (via the offline ER guide, reworded). DLC section from community consensus post-SotE; '≈' level ranges are matchmaking-derived comfort ranges, not requirements. '(verify)' marks claims not re-confirmed in-game.
intro: Elden Ring is open, but there IS a happy path. Do regions in this order, keep your weapon upgrade near the listed tier, and pump Vigor above all else. You only need 2 Great Runes to enter the capital — don't grind every region.

route.boss: Rennala → Great Rune of the Unborn
Gideon → Hoarah Loux → final boss → ending

routeNote: Caelid and Altus are roughly the same tier; many players do Caelid for Radahn, then ride the Dectus Lift up to Altus.
statTargets: Vigor first, always: ~25–30 by Stormveil, ~40 by the capital (first soft cap), ~50–60 endgame.
Just enough of your weapon's requirement stat to wield it, then keep raising your main scaling stat.
Endurance as needed for stamina + equip load (roll fast in your armor).
Mind only if you cast spells/skills a lot.
Upgrade your flasks and weapon every chance you get — they matter more than raw level.

steps.text: Limgrave: get Torrent, the Spirit Calling Bell (Church of Elleh), and the Whetstone Knife (Warmaster's Shack). Explore, hit Graces, upgrade your weapon to +3.
Grab the Dectus Medallion (Left) at Fort Haight while you're in East Limgrave — easy to miss on the rooftop.
Clear the Weeping Peninsula for runes, flask upgrades, and Castle Morne loot (~level 20–30).
Take Stormveil Castle → beat Godrick → Great Rune #1.
Enter Liurnia of the Lakes; explore, upgrade your weapon, raise Vigor toward 30+.
Clear Raya Lucaria Academy → beat Rennala → Great Rune #2 (yes, the Unborn rune counts — it also unlocks respec via Larval Tears).
Recommended: head to Caelid, beat Radahn (opens Nokron); grab the Dectus Medallion (Right) at Fort Faroth while there.
Ride the Grand Lift of Dectus (or climb the Ruin-Strewn Precipice) up to the Altus Plateau.
Talk to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable to confirm your 2 Great Runes, then push into Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Take Leyndell → beat Morgott → his Great Rune.
Through the Forbidden Lands to the Mountaintops of the Giants → beat the Fire Giant.
⚠ Wrap up NPC quests FIRST, then Crumbling Farum Azula → beat Maliketh (triggers the world change).
Return to the burning capital (Leyndell, Capital of Ash) → Gideon, then Hoarah Loux → final boss → your ending.

readiness: Leave a region when you comfortably survive its regular enemies AND your weapon is at that region's tier.
Before Stormveil: weapon +3, Vigor ~20–25, Spirit Calling Bell + summon ashes in hand.
Before the capital: 2 Great Runes, weapon roughly +12–15, Vigor ~40.
If a boss feels impossible you're usually under-upgraded (weapon) or low on Vigor — not just low level.
powerUps: Torrent — given by Melina after resting at a few Graces. Essential.
Spirit Calling Bell + Lone Wolf Ashes — from Renna at the Church of Elleh after you have Torrent. Grab early.
Whetstone Knife / Ashes of War — Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave): change a weapon's skill and affinity at any Grace.
Golden Seeds (more flask charges) + Sacred Tears (stronger flasks) — collect constantly, upgrade at a Grace.
Smithing Stones + Bell Bearings (turn-in at the Twin Maiden Husks) — your weapon upgrade economy.
Memory Stones / Talisman Pouches — more spell slots and talisman slots.
gotchas: The teleporter-trap chest in Dragon-Burnt Ruins warps you to a cage deep in Caelid. Not a bug — escape and leave; come back ~level 60+.
Caelid is reachable absurdly early but is brutal. Don't try to clear it before Liurnia.
Ranni's questline can be permanently broken by carelessly killing or over-progressing Seluvis or Iji — see the Quest Tracker.
Activate the Dectus Lift early: grab the Fort Haight (left) half on your first Limgrave pass.
Point of no return: beating Maliketh changes the world. Finish NPC quests and optional regions before that.
sideBranches: Underground rivers: Siofra → Nokron (opens after Radahn) → Deeproot Depths; Ainsel → Lake of Rot → Nokstella. Ranni's quest + big loot.
Mt. Gelmir / Volcano Manor: Rykard + the assassination questline (finish the letters before fighting him).
Consecrated Snowfield (needs both Haligtree Secret Medallion halves) → Mohgwyn Palace (Mohg) and Miquella's Haligtree (Malenia). Endgame only.

dlc.title: Shadow of the Erdtree (DLC)
entry: Two bosses gate the DLC: beat Starscourge Radahn (Caelid) and Mohg, Lord of Blood (Mohgwyn Palace).
Then touch the withered arm in Mohg's boss arena to cross into the Land of Shadow.
Comfortable entry point: ≈ level 150+, weapon +24/+10 somber. It's tuned for endgame characters.
scadutree: Your character level barely matters in the DLC compared to Scadutree Blessing: collect Scadutree Fragments and spend them at any Site of Grace to raise DLC-only damage dealt AND damage taken reduction (up to blessing level 20).
Revered Spirit Ash Blessing does the same for your Spirit Ashes and Torrent.
If a DLC boss is wrecking you, hunt fragments first — it's the DLC's real progression axis. Fragments are on statues, in churches, and on minor bosses across the map.

route.boss: Divine Beast Dancing Lion (Belurat, Tower Settlement)
route.note: Opening region; grab early Scadutree Fragments before Belurat.
The gate to Scadu Altus; Rellana is an early skill-check — blessing level ≈5+ helps.
Quest crossroads for Miquella's followers; fragments everywhere.
The DLC's central legacy dungeon; his flame gates later story steps.
Dragon pilgrimage; summon Igon's sign outside the arena — you'll know why.
Hidden region below the map; stealth past the Aged Ones — they cannot be fought conventionally.
On the way to the finale; burning the sealing tree follows.
The DLC's hardest wall — blessing 18–20 strongly recommended.
